dedupe_keys.name: analyse de cyclabilite du reseau routier communes dici et uelzechtdall

description: Analyse de cyclabilité du réséau routier (communes DICI et Uelzechtdall) is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics. This database was developed during a study carried out in 2016 by the Ministry of Sustainable Development and Infrastructure in collaboration with the LVI (Lëtzebuerger Vëlosinitiativ) and the municipalities of DICI and Ulezechtdall (Luxemboug-Ville, Strassen, Bertrange, Leudelange, Hesperange, Walferdange, Steinsel, Lorentzweiler, Lintgen, Mersch). Coverage: Ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics. The portal shows the English title as "Cyclability analysis of the road network (DICI and Uelzechtdall municipalities)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics. Its keywords include cyclisme, velo, analyse, suitability, mobiliteit, route. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
